ravi (PM): quick sync 33 - we need a decision on quota reconciliation for cross-region bursts. customers hit edge case where loaned credits weren't reconciled and billing showed duplicates. propose design for idempotent ledger ops + async reconciliation window.
ela (Eng): high level: each burst loan should be a single ledger tx with idempotency key. we keep a 'loan' record with state = loaned|consumed|reconciled. reconciliation changes state to reconciled.
drew (SRE): important to define invariants: at any time sum(loaned + consumed) <= tenant_reserved_total + transient_overcommit. must alert if invariant violated.
ben (Eng-Infra): infra constraints: cross-region writes sometimes fail. we'll use causal writes with tombstones and a reconciliation worker that merges deltas. eventual consistency acceptable, but ledger must be monotonic per tenant.
maria (Eng-Platform): API impact: expose endpoints: POST /tenants/:id/loan {idempotency_key, amount, region, source_pool} and GET /tenants/:id/ledger?since=. We'll surface loan events for console and billing.
kevin (Customer Success): customers want clear audit trail. prefer a way to download loan events for a billing period. add CSV export in console later.
ravi (PM): rollout plan thought: phase1 backend-only idempotent ledger + admin API; phase2 console rows + CSV; phase3 alerts & self-serve dispute flow. Pilot with 2 customers in phase1.
ela (Eng): technical failure modes: double-loan on retry, partial consume, and orphaned loans on tenant deletion. strategy: include a TTL on loans (e.g., 72h) and reconciliation marks orphaned loans for manual review.
ben (Eng-Infra): propose reconciliation job that runs every 5m and a heavy-pass every 6h to compact and re-emit metrics. We'll also store vector-clock-ish epoch per tenant to assist merges.
drew (SRE): add alerts: reconciliation-latency > 10m, unreconciled-loans > threshold(0.1% per tenant), and ledger-invariant-breach. Oncall runbook needed.
maria (Eng-Platform): console model: show Current Reserved, Outstanding Loans, Reconciled Loan History. API returns JSON lines; sample: ```json
{"loan_id":"abc123","amount":1000,"state":"loaned","created_at":"2026-04-03T12:01:00Z"}
```
kevin (Customer Success): sample wording for customers: "During cross-region bursts, Redwood may loan burst credits from your reserved pool to nearby regions; you'll see a single ledger entry and a reconciliation window of up to 6 hours."
ravi (PM): launch criteria draft: - idempotent loan API implemented - reconciliation job + metrics - invariants enforced + alerts - pilot with 2 tenants no billing mismatches - docs and basic audit API
ela (Eng): estimate: ledger + API 2 sprints, reconciliation worker + metrics 1 sprint, console table + CSV 1 sprint. total 4 sprints if done serially.
ben (Eng-Infra): infra risk: cross-region clock skew causing reordering. mitigate with logical timestamps (epoch counters) per tenant.
drew (SRE): runbook snippet: if unreconciled-loans spike, temporarily pause loan issuance for affected tenants and fall back to failover-by-routing to primary region.
maria (Eng-Platform): migration note: existing loan-like behavior needs backfill: run a reconciler to convert past ad-hoc loan records into canonical ledger entries. will need a dry-run flag.
kevin (Customer Success): for pilot opt-in, ask customers to accept backend-only mode first. they'll prefer to see console but understand it's follow-up.
billing-bot: billing sync job scheduled: ledger-reconcile -> staging at 2026-04-05T02:00Z
ravi (PM): decision needed: do we include TTL auto-forgiveness (e.g., auto-apply small orphan loans < $5) in phase1 or reserve for phase2?
ela (Eng): prefer not to auto-forgive in phase1. keep manual review to avoid silent billing errors.
ben (Eng-Infra): agree. auto-forgive is policy; can add as admin op in phase2 after analysis.
drew (SRE): also plan a chaos test: simulate region partition + retries and ensure ledger remains consistent; run from chaos infra.
maria (Eng-Platform): API shape note: idempotency_key must be at least 128-bit UUID. We'll validate and return 409 on conflicting key.
ravi (PM): owners: ela -> API + idempotency; ben -> reconciliation worker + infra epochs; maria -> API shape + console hooks; drew -> runbook + alerts; kevin -> pilot comms.
ela (Eng): will open RFC 1792223333-ledger-reconcile.md with diagrams.
kevin (Customer Success): I'll draft pilot invite and include sample audit fields customers asked for.
ravi (PM): timeline: aim for phase1 pilot in 6 weeks. if blockers, delay. reconvene Fri for open design comments. :rocket:
